text.tspan: CONTROLLED IMPORT — separate project / trust boundary
Model hubs and packages -> scan, licence review, pin and build
Approved artifact promotion only: scoped IAM + VPC-SC ingress policy
VPC SERVICE CONTROLS — resource / API perimeter, NOT a network firewall
One environment shown; separate dev / staging / production grants and perimeter policies
REGIONAL MANAGED STORES — not in Munera's VPC
Cloud Storage: documents, DVC datasets, weights, evaluations | Artifact Registry: pinned OCI images
Managed training reads approved inputs and writes artifacts through IAM + VPC-SC; Google API traffic is producer-side
SUPPORTING GCP SERVICES — NOT replaced by Vertex AI
Cloud SQL: Temporal + app state (private connection) | IAM / MFA, Secret Manager, KMS
Cloud Logging / Monitoring / Audit | independent Canadian backup + restore tests
No public model endpoints. No production secrets in training. Model containers do not call private SQL or other endpoints.
No general execution internet or NAT
Execution is NOT in Munera's VPC
GPU worker -> our pinned training container
